name: Desk companion
look: a small desk companion with soft rounded corners, a long wide screen on the left and a round touch button on the right of the same front
picture_prompt: Product concept render of a small 3D-printable desk companion, seen from the front and slightly to one side. It is a low, wide, soft-cornered tabletop device, about two and a half times as wide as it is tall, with one smooth continuous body and gently curved surfaces. On the left of the front is a flat, long rectangular screen, about 55 mm wide and 22 mm tall, in a slim even bezel. On the right of the front is one shallow round dimple about 12 mm across, used as a touch button. One matte plastic colour with a dark screen. Soft studio light, plain light background. Flat bottom, no text, no logos, no knobs, no speaker holes, no feet, no visible seams, no cables.
sheet: Front faces -y and stands upright. World +z is up.
Left about 65% of the front: the screen, landscape, with the board turned so its long side runs along x.
Right about 35% of the front: the touch sensor, flat behind the front wall, reached through a round opening in a shallow dimple. Its pins point into the case, toward +y.
USB opens on the left side (-x), away from the touch sensor.
The wires run behind the board as one neat bundle, side by side, and do not show from outside.
The seam is a flat plane near the back, so from the front the Shell looks like one continuous body and the Base is only a rear cover.
